accepted.name: photoobj_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  objid,
  run,
  rerun,
  field,
  mode,
  type,
  clean,
  flags,
  rowc,
  colc,
  cmodelmag_u,
  cmodelmag_g,
  cmodelmag_r,
  ra,
  dec,
  b,
  l,
  extinction_r,
  mjd,
  loadversion,
  u,
  g,
  r,
  i,
  z
FROM photoobj
accepted.description: Normalized photometric object projection exposing primary positional, magnitude, and metadata columns with a simple cleaning of magnitudes (pass-through NULLs preserved). Use this as the canonical photoobj row for joins or downstream aggregations. | Use for: Retrieve photometry for objects by spatial region; Join photometry to spectra via bestobjid; Compute color indices or magnitude-limited samples

accepted.name: photo_type_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  value,
  name,
  description
FROM photo_type
accepted.description: Dimension table for photo type codes. Use to translate photoobj.type into human-friendly name/description when joining with photometric rows. | Use for: Map photo type codes to labels for reporting; Filter photometry by type categories by joining to this lookup

accepted.name: specobj_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  specobjid,
  bestobjid,
  plateid,
  scienceprimary,
  segue2primary,
  survey,
  programname,
  mjd,
  plate,
  fiberid,
  special_target1,
  segue2_target1,
  segue2_target2,
  ancillary_target1,
  ra,
  dec,
  z,
  zerr,
  zwarning,
  class,
  subclass,
  veldisp,
  veldisperr,
  loadversion
FROM specobj
accepted.description: Canonical projection of spectroscopic objects exposing identification, redshift, classification and metadata. Useful for joins to photoobj via bestobjid or for filtering spectra by z/class. | Use for: Select spectra by redshift or class; Join spectra to photometry via bestobjid; Compute statistics of z or velocity dispersion per program/survey
